lines.en: label day26:
scene hall_noon
I make my way back to the classroom after a quick trip to the teacher's lounge because, for some reason (Likely in regard to my new teaching methods), Makoto wants to speak with me.
lines.zh: 我刚去了一趟教员休息室，正往教室赶，因为不知为何（大概跟我那套新教学法有关），Makoto 想找我谈谈。

lines.en: I was under the impression that she'd already gotten used to these methods on account of her distinct lack of complaints lately, but I guess...too much was too much. Or something.
lines.zh: 我本以为她已经习惯这套做法了，毕竟她最近明显没什么抱怨，不过我想……再能忍也有个限度吧。大概。

lines.en: I have no idea. I just hope she doesn't expect me to change because- let's face it. I am not cut out to be the teacher she wants me to be.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。我只希望她别指望我改变，因为——说实话，我根本不是当她想要的那种老师的料。

lines.en: scene black
I sigh to myself and make my way into the classroom, not really knowing what to expect.
lines.zh: 我自顾自叹了口气，走进教室，完全不知道会面对什么。

lines.en: scene makalone1
: Okay...You can do this, Makoto. You are strong...and admirable...and...at least not entirely unattractive.
lines.zh: : 好的……你能行的，Makoto。你很坚强……又令人敬佩……而且……至少也不算完全没有魅力。

lines.en: : Yeah...yeah! What's the worst that could happen?
lines.zh: : 对……对！最坏又能坏到哪儿去？

lines.en: : I mean...you could get rejected by the man you admire more than anyone else...or he could think you're a creep for even considering something like this, but...
lines.zh: : 我是说……你可能会被那个你最仰慕的男人拒绝……或者他会觉得你连想这种事都很恶心，不过……

lines.en: if firsttimepornshop == True:
: But it’s not like he’s all that innocent, either!
lines.zh: : 可他也不是什么省油的灯啊！

lines.en: : In fact, he’s even worse! Just...waltzing into a porn shop in the middle of the night! Just how much of a pervert is he?!
lines.zh: : 事实上他更过分！居然……大半夜大摇大摆走进成人用品店！他到底是有多变态啊？！

lines.en: : But...then again...it's not like I'm not into that sort of thing. I just...I...
lines.zh: : 不过……话又说回来……我也不是对那种事没兴趣。我只是……我……

lines.en: : Mm!
else:
: No...No! Sensei would never think I would have ulterior motives. He knows me better than that.
lines.zh: : 不……不！Sensei 绝不会觉得我别有用心。他比那更了解我。

lines.en: : P-Plus! It’s not like they’re even motives to begin with...this is just...to help me understand him better! Yeah!
lines.zh: : 而、而且！这本来也算不上什么用心……这只是……为了帮我更了解他！对！

lines.en: : Ugh...
Interesting. It seems as if I'm not going to get yelled at at all and that, instead, I’ve stumbled into some sort of soliloquy.
lines.zh: 有意思。看来我根本不会被骂，反倒是误打误撞撞进了某种独白现场。

lines.en: That said, I should probably snap Makoto out of it before she reveals a little too much and winds up regretting something.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我还是该趁早把 Makoto 从这种状态里拽出来，免得她说漏太多，最后后悔。

lines.en: : Hey.
scene makalone2
: Great...now I'm even hearing his voice. Could this day get any worse?
lines.zh: : 好极了……现在连他的声音我都幻听到了。这天还能更糟点吗？

lines.en: : I've been trying to reach you about your car's extended warranty.
lines.zh: : 我一直在联系您，是关于您汽车的延长保修服务。

lines.en: scene makalone2r
: You're actually there, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 你是真的在那儿吧？

lines.en: : Yup.
scene black
Makoto slaps her cheeks to force herself back into her default setting of being a knowledge robot before turning around to meet me...
lines.zh: Makoto 拍了拍自己的脸颊，把自己强行调回「知识机器人」的默认模式，然后转过身来面对我……

lines.en: scene makalone3
: How much of that did you hear, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底听到了多少？

lines.en: : For the sake of preserving your mental health, none of it.
lines.zh: : 为了你的心理健康着想，一个字都没听到。

lines.en: : And for the sake that doesn't care at all about my mental health?
lines.zh: : 那要是完全不顾我的心理健康呢？

lines.en: : Enough to know you love me.
lines.zh: : 多到足够让我知道，你爱我。

lines.en: scene makalone4
: L-Love?! No one said anything about love!
lines.zh: : 爱……爱？！谁说过什么爱不爱的！

lines.en: : Forget I even asked for the truth and just...go back to pretending you didn't hear anything! It'll make what I'm about to say significantly easier for me!
lines.zh: : 就当我没问过真相，你……继续装作什么都没听见吧！那样我接下来要说的话会容易得多！

lines.en: : Really? Because I feel like a confession would be easier if we both know what we're walking into.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我倒觉得，如果我们双方都清楚自己正走进什么局面，告白会更容易些。

lines.en: scene makalone5
: This...isn't a confession, though.
lines.zh: : 这……才不是告白呢。

lines.en: : It's not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Of course not...don't be ridiculous.
lines.zh: : 当然不是……别犯傻了。

lines.en: : That sort of thing between a teacher and a student? Let alone us? No...No, that would never work.
lines.zh: : 老师和学生之间发生那种事？更别提是我俩？不……不，那绝对不可能成。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那到底是——

lines.en: : Do you...remember what happened in your office the other day?
lines.zh: : 你还……记得前几天在你办公室发生的事吗？

lines.en: : You mean the massage?
lines.zh: : 你是指按摩？

lines.en: : Y...Yeah.
: Well...I’ve been thinking about that a lot since then and-
lines.zh: : 嗯……从那以后我就一直在想那件事，然后——

lines.en: : Name the time and place and we can do it again whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你说时间和地点，我们随时可以再来一次。

lines.en: scene makalone6
: That's just the thing! I don't want to do it again!
lines.zh: : 问题就在这儿！我根本不想再来一次！

lines.en: : My inability to get it off of my mind doesn't have anything to do with some...unquenchable thirst for more!
lines.zh: : 我之所以忘不掉，跟什么……难以抑制的、想要更多的渴望一点关系都没有！

lines.en: : The reason I can’t stop thinking about it is because of how absurdly inappropriate it was for both of us to be a part of something like that!
lines.zh: : 我之所以停不下来，是因为我俩卷进那种事里，实在荒唐得过分、太不合适了！

lines.en: : If...If any of the other girls knew what happened in there...I don’t even want to know what they would think about me.
lines.zh: : 要是……要是其他女生知道了里面发生了什么……我连想都不敢想她们会怎么看我。

lines.en: scene makalone5
: I'm already seen as a bit of a teacher's pet...so I need to be very careful when it comes to things like this, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我已经被当成老师的跟屁虫了……所以我在这类事上必须格外小心，Sensei。

lines.en: : So, just...don't touch you from now on? Is that what you're asking?
lines.zh: : 所以，就是……从现在开始别碰你？你是在要求这个吗？

lines.en: scene makalone7
: Precisely. It’s not only inappropriate, but entirely immoral given our relationship.
lines.zh: : 正是。考虑到我们的关系，这不仅不合适，而且完全不道德。

lines.en: : If that's what you want, sure.
lines.zh: : 如果这是你想要的，当然可以。

lines.en: : I'm not really sure if I think any of what you said warrants walking away from something you were clearly interested in, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不太确定，你说的这些是否足以让你放弃一件你明显很感兴趣的事。

lines.en: scene makalone8
: My interest in it is beside the point, Sensei! I was very obviously enjoying myself! Perhaps even too much!
lines.zh: : 我对那件事有没有兴趣根本不是重点，Sensei！我当时显然非常享受！甚至可能享受过头了！

lines.en: : I'm sure this is no surprise to you, but no one has ever touched-
lines.zh: : 我想你听到这个也不会意外，从来没有人碰过——

lines.en: : I'm going to cut you off right there because this is definitely not something you should be yelling in a classroom.
lines.zh: : 我得在这里打断你一下，因为这绝对不是你该在教室里喊出来的东西。

lines.en: scene makalone5
: Ugh...Look what you’re making me say. Now I’m even more worked up.
lines.zh: : 呃……看看你逼我都说了些什么。我现在更激动了。

lines.en: : I’m not making you say anything. You just started yelling after I said something that made too much sense.
lines.zh: : 我可没逼你说什么。是我说了句太有道理的话，你才开始大喊大叫的。

lines.en: scene makalone7
: Well, whatever the case...I don’t think it’s something we should be doing on[school] grounds anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样……我觉得这种事以后不该再在[school]里做了。

lines.en: : You realize that implies that it would be fine off of school grounds, right?
lines.zh: : 你意识到这话的言下之意是，在校外就没关系了吧？

lines.en: Makoto breathes in deeply and holds the air inside of her for what feels like a full minute.
lines.zh: Makoto 深深吸了一口气，把那口气在肺里憋了感觉整整一分钟。

lines.en: The sound of footsteps and chatter from outside of the classroom bleeds in through the thin walls and reinforces the notion in the back of my head that all of this is wrong.
lines.zh: 教室外脚步声和谈笑声透过薄薄的墙渗进来，愈发坚定了我脑海深处那个念头：这一切都是错的。

lines.en: And what I'm sure is about to come next is perhaps the most wrong of all.
lines.zh: 而我敢肯定，接下来要发生的事，或许是其中最错的一件。

lines.en: scene makalone10
: That's...actually part of what I wanted to talk to you about.
lines.zh: : 那……其实也是我想跟你谈的事之一。

lines.en: scene makalone11
: Again, this is not a confession...
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这不是告白……

lines.en: : But there's been something I've been very interested in for quite a while now and...
lines.zh: : 不过有件事我已经感兴趣很久了，然后……

lines.en: scene makalone11r
: And that thing just so happens to be you.
lines.zh: : 而那件事，恰好就是你。

lines.en: : Again, this is not a confession.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这不是告白。

lines.en: : Each time you say that just makes it sound more like a confession, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你每说一次，听起来就更像告白一点，Makoto。

lines.en: : I...know this might sound stupid since I’m still [young]and shouldn’t even be worrying about this kind of stuff yet, but...
lines.zh: : 我……知道这听起来可能很蠢，毕竟我还[young]，本来就不该操心这种事，不过……

lines.en: scene makalone11
: I just want to try seeing what it’s like not worrying about[school] and...work all the time.
lines.zh: : 我只是想体验一下，不去操心[school]、不去操心……永远在工作的感觉。

lines.en: : I want to lay down some nights and think ‘Wow. Today was a really good day.’
lines.zh: : 我想有些晚上躺下时能想「哇。今天真是美好的一天」。

lines.en: scene makalone12
: And I guess I...never really get that.
lines.zh: : 而我大概……从来没有过这种感觉。

lines.en: : Every day is the same thing. Over and over and over. It's like...I'm stuck in a loop or something.
lines.zh: : 每一天都是同样的东西。一遍又一遍又一遍。就好像……我卡在某个循环里了什么的。

lines.en: : I get that. But what do you want me to do about it?
lines.zh: : 我懂。可你想让我为此做点什么？

lines.en: scene makalone13
: Huh?
: How am I supposed to help? What can I do to help you not feel like you're...stuck in a loop or whatever?
lines.zh: : 我该怎么帮？我能做些什么，好让你不再觉得自己……卡在循环里什么的？

lines.en: : You don’t have to do anything different, really...And I say that knowing that your personality could do a complete 180 again any day now.
lines.zh: : 你其实什么都不用改变……而我这么说，是在明知你的性格随时可能再来个 180 度大转弯的前提下。

lines.en: scene makalone14
: You’ve...changed a lot over the last few weeks...And I’m not saying that’s a bad thing.
lines.zh: : 这几个星期你……变了很多……我并不是说那是坏事。

lines.en: : I’ve always admired you for your intellect and your dedication, but you’ve always seemed a little...closed-off.
lines.zh: : 我一直很敬佩你的才智和投入，可你以前总显得有点……封闭。

lines.en: : Which is why it was always hard for me to tell you how I feel.
lines.zh: : 所以我一直很难对你说出我的感受。

lines.en: : But...you’ve seemed more open lately. And I’m less worried about things like that now.
lines.zh: : 不过……你最近看起来开朗多了。而我也没那么担心那些事了。

lines.en: : And it got me thinking-
lines.zh: : 这让我开始想——

lines.en: : If you can change your mindset and start changing yourself...why can't I?
lines.zh: : 如果你能改变自己的心态、开始改变自己……那我为什么不行？

lines.en: scene makalone15
: So...here’s where you come in.
lines.zh: : 所以……这就是你需要出场的地方。

lines.en: : Every once in a while, and I don’t care when...I’d like to see you outside of[school].
lines.zh: : 偶尔——什么时候都行……我想在[school]之外见你。

lines.en: : Ahh. So it's not a confession, but you are asking me on a date. Is that right?
lines.zh: : 啊。所以这不是告白，但你是在约我出去。对吗？

lines.en: : No. That's not right at all.
lines.zh: : 不。完全不对。

lines.en: Teenagers are exhausting.
lines.zh: 青少年真累人。

lines.en: : What I'm looking for could be something as simple as just...going for a walk. Or going out for coffee.
lines.zh: : 我想要的可以简单到只是……去散个步。或者出去喝杯咖啡。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: : 所以——

lines.en: : Stop it. It's not a date.
lines.zh: : 别说了。这不是约会。

lines.en: : You just seem to know a lot about what it means to live a fulfilling life...so I want to learn more about that from you. Firsthand, without worrying about school getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很懂得怎样才算活得充实……所以我想从你身上多学点这个。亲身地学，不用担心学校碍事。

lines.en: A fulfilling life, huh?
lines.zh: 充实的人生，是吗？

lines.en: Is that really what this is?
lines.zh: 这真的就是眼下的事吗？

lines.en: Taking control of someone else’s body?
lines.zh: 占据别人的身体？

lines.en: Stepping in and single-handedly dismantling everything they built?
lines.zh: 插手进去，亲手拆掉他们建起的一切？

lines.en: Is this really what it means to be fulfilled?
lines.zh: 这真的就是「充实」的含义吗？

lines.en: : I'm not sure how much you're planning on learning, but if it means hanging out with you outside of school...sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定你打算学到多少，不过如果这意味着在校外跟你一起出去玩……行啊。

lines.en: : That's fine by me.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。

lines.en: scene makalone16
: Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I'm glad we were able to reach an understanding then. I promise I'll try not to bother you too much.
lines.zh: : 那很高兴我们能达成共识。我保证会尽量少来烦你。

lines.en: : I'm already getting used to being bothered by pretty much everyone, so don't worry too much about that.
lines.zh: : 我已经习惯被几乎所有人都烦了，所以这方面你别太放在心上。

lines.en: : Is it really that bothersome having to watch over a handful of teenage girls?
lines.zh: : 要照看一群十几岁的女生，真的有那么烦人吗？

lines.en: : You'd be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: : Heheh...you're right. I think I would.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……你说得对。我想我会的。

lines.en: : But perhaps learning how to deal with that is just one more thing you can teach me during our time together.
lines.zh: : 不过，学会怎么应付这件事，或许也是你我在一起的这段时间里能教我的又一样东西。

lines.en: : It's bound to come in handy some day, I'm sure...
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，总有一天会派上用场的……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and I spend the rest of afternoon straightening up the classroom before ultimately separating.
lines.zh: 我和 Makoto 用剩下的半天时间收拾教室，之后才各自离开。

lines.en: And while the air was heavy upon entering the classroom a few minutes ago, it's gone back to normal now and the two of us are able to breathe easy again.
lines.zh: 几分钟前我踏进教室时空气还很沉重，可现在一切如常，我俩都又能轻松地喘口气了。

lines.en: As we leave the building and fade out of each other's field of vision, something crosses my mind.
lines.zh: 当我们走出教学楼、从彼此的视野里消失时，有个念头闪过我的脑海。

lines.en: What if I'm not able to help Makoto escape from the life she’s grown so tired of?
lines.zh: 要是我没法帮 Makoto 从她早已厌倦的生活里逃出去呢？

lines.en: What happens then?
lines.zh: 那会怎样？

lines.en: I guess there's only one way to find out.
lines.zh: 我想，只有一种办法能知道答案。

lines.en: Here's hoping I don't have to.
lines.zh: 但愿我不用走到那一步。

lines.en: And here's hoping I make a suitable raft for her to float away on.
lines.zh: 也但愿我能替她造一艘合适的筏子，让她漂走。

$ day26 = True
Makoto's affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
lines.zh: Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！
